messages.subject: Design of a dataframe for unmarked for opportunistic camera trap survey
parts:
Hi, 

I try to run an occupancy analysis using an opportunistic camera trap study survey, where cameras were active in different parts of the study area in different periods of time within a year. To account for this diversity I decided to use precipitation linked to the camera station and the time period when the camera was active.
I have multiple years and want to compare them, thus the idea is to run separate model for each year.

I have a question regarding the input dataframe design of the species observations. At the moment my dataframe looks like this (the top table). When we have 2 weeks time periods and observations + NA for inactive camera station within each time window.



I have been told that this is incorrect and I should move all my observations to the left to avoid NA between revisits and to remove the end columns with revisits holding NA only (the bottom table). Is that correct?


I would really appreciate if somebody can provide any advice on that.
